title: Mall travel hub/hotel?
content: How it blends together in my dreams..velvet all over besides the gold accents, there are so many floors filled with hotel rooms and they never seem to end and lots of escalators and stairs (that lead to all sorts of places in the mall theres no signs you just know where it goes) on one end of the building. I was looking across the way and noticed this lady watching me then I woke up and I've never been able to get back to that place. I miss having these dreams and they seemed to have stopped after that
